name: Discovery Call
title: Not sure what would actually move the needle? Let's find out — free.
lede: A short, no-pressure 1:1 to understand where you are, what's really in your way, and whether working together makes sense. You leave with clear next steps either way.
reassure: No pitch, no obligation — just a straight read on what would help most.
forYou: Weighing whether mentorship or interview prep is worth it
Not sure which service fits your situation

notForYou: You already know what you need — book that service directly
You're looking for a full working session (this is a short intro)

Tell me where you are and what you're aiming for; I'll ask a few sharp questions.
A clear recommendation on what would actually help — whether that's working together or not.

faq.a: Yes. The discovery call is free and there's no obligation to book anything afterwards.

faq.q: Will you try to sell me something?
faq.a: No. If a paid service is genuinely the right next step I'll say so, but the goal is an honest read on what would help — even if that's advice you can act on alone.

faq.q: Can I get resume or interview feedback on this call?
faq.a: Not in depth — 15 minutes is for orientation and next steps. For hands-on work, we'd book the relevant session.

faq.q: What should I come prepared with?
faq.a: Just a clear sense of where you are and what you're trying to achieve. That's enough for a useful conversation.

finalCta.title: Let's figure out the right next step.
finalCta.sub: Grab a free 15-minute slot — no payment, no pressure.
